# Pull Request Template

## Description
Please include a brief summary of the change, the rationale behind it, and what issue/feature it addresses.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (non-breaking change to guides or manifests)
- [ ] Refactoring / Style polish (visual tweaks or code organization)

## Verification Checklist
Before submitting, please ensure you have completed the following:
- [ ] I have verified the build compiles locally (`npm run build`).
- [ ] I have run the unit test suite and verified all specs pass (`npm test`).
- [ ] I have added new Jasmine unit tests covering my changes (if applicable).
- [ ] I have verified visual changes on the local demo app (`npm start`).
- [ ] I have confirmed styling and theme variables match the Light/Dark tokens.
- [ ] I have checked accessibility (focus-visible outlines, ARIA attributes).
